strength.week.label: Strength
strength.home.title: Strength
strength.home.intro: Build workouts, log every set and follow your progress. Everything stays on this phone.
strength.home.templatesEmpty: No saved workouts yet. Build one, or tap a template below.
strength.home.exercisesEmpty: Exercises you have trained will show up here.
strength.home.exportHint: Strength sessions, sets, templates and custom exercises are part of the export (CSV files).
strength.builder.title: Workout template
strength.builder.intro: Pick exercises and set a target for sets, reps and weight.
strength.builder.name: Name
strength.builder.itemsEmpty: No exercises yet. Add one below.
strength.builder.targetHint: Sets {setsMin}–{setsMax}, reps {repsMin}–{repsMax}, weight {weightMin}–{weightMax} {unit}. Use 0 for bodyweight.
strength.builder.errorName: Give the template a name of 1 to {max} characters.
strength.builder.tooMany: A template holds up to {max} exercises.
strength.picker.title: Choose an exercise
strength.picker.none: No exercise matches. Create it below.
strength.picker.more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Search to narrow down.
strength.picker.name: Exercise name
strength.picker.exists: An exercise with that name exists already.
strength.picker.deleteHint: Deleting a custom exercise keeps your logged sets.
strength.live.title: Workout
strength.live.noneBody: Start one from the Strength screen.
strength.live.hrOff: Live heart rate is off. The workout works without it. The summary still shows heart rate if the band recorded it.
strength.live.hrWaiting: Waiting for a heart rate reading…
strength.live.restDone: Rest is over. Ready for the next set.
strength.live.finishNeedsSet: Log at least one set to finish.
strength.live.empty: Add an exercise to start logging sets.
strength.summary.title: Workout summary
strength.summary.emptyBody: Finish a workout and its summary shows up here.
strength.summary.volumeNote: Volume is reps × weight, added up over all sets. Bodyweight sets (weight 0) add no volume.
strength.summary.hrNone: No heart rate samples were recorded between the start and the finish of this workout.
strength.summary.hrNote: From the band samples in that window. Values are averages per 10 seconds.
strength.motion.line: Band: {reps} reps · {tut} s under tension · {tempo} s per rep
strength.motion.unreadable: Motion not readable for this exercise
strength.motion.unmatched: Motion recorded, but it could not be matched to your sets
strength.motion.title: High-rate motion
strength.motion.bandRecordingBody: For when your phone stays in a locker. Uses band memory and adds about 13 minutes to the next sync per hour.
strength.summary.loadBodyMotion: Volume load per main muscle group: reps × weight. Sets the band measured can be weighted by rep tempo against your own earlier sets (0.7–1.3×); that weighting is not switched on yet, so the load shown is plain volume. Own method, not comparable to other apps.
strength.summary.loadBody: Volume load per main muscle group: reps × weight of the sets of exercises with that main muscle. A plain volume count, not a measure of physiological strain.
strength.exercise.title: Exercise details
strength.exercise.pickEmpty: Finish a workout to build exercise history.
strength.exercise.notFound: This exercise has no finished sets yet.
strength.exercise.rmNote: Estimated with Epley’s formula (1985): weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30), from sets of 1 to 12 reps. An estimate, not a tested maximum.
strength.exercise.rmNone: No weighted set of 1 to 12 reps yet, so there is no estimate.
strength.trends.title: Strength trends
strength.trends.musclesBody: Total over the chosen period, by main muscle group. Reps × weight, not a measure of physiological strain.
strength.trends.empty: No finished workouts in this period.
strength.load.noData: no Load: no heart rate recorded
strength.load.lowCoverage: no Load: too little heart rate
strength.home.coachBody: Describe a session, get sets and reps
strength.preset.hint: Tap a template to add it to your saved workouts. You set the weights.
strength.preset.added: Added: {names}. Set the weights before you start.
strength.preset.failed: The template could not be added. Try again.
strength.builder.dragHint: Drag the handle to change the order.
strength.builder.runningHint: A workout is running. Finish it before you start another.
strength.coach.placeholder: Describe your workout, like 45 min push
strength.coach.sending: The coach is building your workout…
strength.coach.filled: Exercises filled in by the coach: {count}. Check them, then save.
strength.coach.dropped: Suggestions left out because they did not fit your exercise list or the limits: {count}.
strength.coach.privacy: Sent to Anthropic with your own API key: this description, your exercise list and your recent working weights. Nothing is saved until you save.
strength.coach.nothing: The coach found no exercise from your list for this. Nothing changed.
strength.coach.describeHint: Describe the workout in {min} to {max} characters.
strength.coach.offKey: The coach can turn a description into exercises, sets and reps. Add your own Anthropic API key in Coach settings to use it.
strength.coach.offNetwork: Network access for the coach is off. Turn it on in Coach settings to build a workout from a description.
strength.coach.error.rejected: Anthropic rejected the request. Try a shorter description.
strength.coach.error.incomplete: The reply was cut off. Try a shorter description.
strength.coach.error.invalid: The reply could not be turned into exercises. Nothing changed. Try again.
strength.live.buzz: Buzz the band when rest is over
strength.live.buzzOn: The band is connected and buzzes once when the countdown ends, while this screen is open.
strength.live.buzzOff: The band is not connected right now, so it will not buzz. The timer still runs.
strength.live.loadNote: From the heart rate of this workout so far.
strength.summary.shareSubtitle: An image of the card below. Nothing leaves your phone until you pick an app.
strength.summary.recordsNote: Compared with your earlier workouts with the same exercise: heaviest set, most reps at a weight and best volume.
strength.summary.figureNone: Muscle map. No muscle group trained.
strength.exercise.volumeUnit: Volume per session in {unit}: reps × weight of all sets.
strength.exercise.bestVolumeNone: No volume yet: bodyweight sets add none
strength.trends.minutesNote: Minutes from finished strength workouts and strength activities, counted the same way as your weekly plan.
strength.trends.goalSessions: About {count} of your usual sessions does it.
strength.trends.noGoal: Your weekly plan has no strength goal, so there is nothing to measure these minutes against.
strength.trends.noPlan: There is no weekly plan yet. A plan sets how many strength minutes you aim for each week.
strength.trends.changeNone: No volume in the same days of the period before to compare with.
strength.trends.changeNote: Against the same number of days in the period before.
strength.preset.existing: Already in your saved workouts: {names}. Tap it there to edit or start it.
